name: Oundle School Chapel

layers.essential_history: [[c:Oundle School grew from Laxton Grammar School, founded in 1556 under the will of Sir William Laxton, a grocer who became Lord Mayor of London. The Worshipful Company of Grocers still runs the school.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:A school existed in Oundle by at least 1465. Former pupils include the scientist Richard Dawkins and Iron Maiden singer Bruce Dickinson. Please look from the road: the school is private.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The schoolmaster vouches for Tom: the boy was back in his bed by one o'clock, and the school door was barred. (Long walk only: this clears Tom.)]]

evidence: [[c:Tom was back in school by one o'clock: he could not have hidden anything after that.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 220 metres as the crow flies, to West Street and the Stahl Theatre. Head down to West Street. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The school bell]]
material: [[c:SCHOOLMASTER: "The bell rang at nine for bed. I checked every boy at midnight, and again an hour later. Tom was asleep both times."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:At what hour did the schoolmaster check the boys the second time? (just the number)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:One o'clock. Tom was asleep at midnight and at one, so he could not have hidden the crown.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]
